text:
jamie: Hey all — opened PR #4127 to split runtime-config from runtime-core into two modules. Main goals: reduce cross-imports, tighten types for config surface, and make plugins importable without pulling full runtime. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4127 :link:

nina: taking a look now. quick Q — did you keep the old barrel files for a deprecation cycle or fully break them?

jamie: removed the old barrels, added a migration guide in the PR description. plan was to cut a minor with deprecation notes.

alex: i can do a style pass later today. main thing i'm worried about is the public API names — are we sure about `ConfigLayer` vs `RuntimeConfig`?

jamie: good call. i kept both for now but exported only RuntimeConfig from the top-level package. ConfigLayer is internal under runtime-config/src/internal. open to renaming if you think it reads better.

ci-bot: Build started for PR #4127. Tests: 482 run, 0 failed so far. (reacted with :spinner:)

sam: quick perf note — when i ran the local smoke tests, import graph improved but cold-start for a couple services increased ~50ms. could be the lazy-init order. logging snippet below:
```
2026-03-17T10:02:01Z runtime-core init: 45ms
2026-03-17T10:02:01Z runtime-config init: 95ms
```

lisa: thanks for catching perf. jamie, can you try deferring the plugin loader until after config resolves? might shave that extra time.

jamie: sure, i'll try a lazy require and push another commit.

alex: style pass notes — 3 small nits: trailing commas in a couple files, prefer named exports in `index.ts` to make tree-shaking clearer, and update a couple JSDoc blocks. i'll post a review with inline comments.

jamie: awesome, thanks. pinging for approvals — @nina @alex @kevin can one of you approve after the changes? hoping to merge by EOD if CI stays green.

nina: i left 2 comments about types; one is just a nit, one might need a tiny helper function. i'll approve once that's addressed.

kevin: eyeballing now. don’t forget to run `yarn build:packages` before pushing — saw a missing dist in a prior split.

jamie: i pushed a fix for build and the lazy plugin init. kicked CI again.

ci-bot: Build passed for PR #4127. All checks green. (reacted with :white_check_mark:)

alex: approved. small followups in review but not blocking.

nina: approved after helper added.

kevin: approved — i want to do a quick canary deploy tomorrow to sanity-check the runtime in staging, but feel free to merge.

jamie: thanks all! i'll merge after a short slack-lock window (5m) to let anyone else chime in. if no objections i'll merge in ~10m. :thumbsup:

lisa: no objections from infra. thanks for the cleanup.

jamie: merging now.

ci-bot: PR #4127 merged by jamie. Changeset: runtime-config split. (reacted with :tada:)
